summary: Origin Agritech filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited financial results for the six months ended March 31, 2026. The filing discloses net revenue of RMB49.2 million (US$7.1 million), operating loss of RMB12.9 million (US$1.9 million), and net loss attributable to the Company of RMB14.4 million (US$2.1 million). It describes changes in revenue, operating expenses, and net loss compared to the prior period. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other corporate event is announced. The filing contains no deal terms or structural changes to the company's capital structure.
